text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses large neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is used in many everyday situations. For example, it helps recommend movies on streaming sites, powers voice assistants on phones, and even helps doctors find diseases. AI is also used in self-driving cars and online shopping. As AI continues to grow, it will change how we live and work.
